subject: Invitation to Company Networking Event
body: Dear valued employees, You are invited to our annual company networking event taking place on Friday, 15th October at 6:00 PM. This event will provide a great opportunity to connect with colleagues from different departments and build professional relationships. Delicious food and drinks will be served. Please RSVP by replying to this email by 10th October. We look forward to seeing you there! Best regards, [Company Name]
